business_problem: Mastek's rapid global growth exposed manual service processes, inconsistent workflows, and fragmented tools, making it difficult to automate onboarding, incidents, and enterprise support with strong compliance.
solution_summary: Mastek standardized enterprise service delivery on ServiceNow IT Service Management and used bi-directional integrations to connect the tools employees already relied on rather than running separate service silos. ITSM became the system of action across internal IT, HR, finance, visitor management, cybersecurity, and application maintenance. Microsoft Teams, Intune, and email were tied into the workflow layer so employees could request help and trigger actions from familiar channels. Operational automation was extended with a software metering tool and Intune for automatic software deployment, while monitoring tools pushed outage data into ITSM so scripts could restart services and close tickets without manual intervention. For visibility, Mastek connected the platform to Microsoft Azure Data Lake and Microsoft Power BI, creating one dashboard for support analytics, long-running cases, and continuous process improvement.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Power BI

data_flow: Requests arrive through Microsoft Teams, email, service forms, or monitoring integrations and land in IT Service Management. Automation uses Intune and software-metering data to deploy or approve software, incident scripts restart failed services, and operational data is pushed to Microsoft Azure Data Lake and Microsoft Power BI for dashboarding and process analysis.
business_outcome: Mastek automated more than a third of service requests, scaled service levels while increasing IT staffing by only 15% during 5x company growth, reduced software deployment time from eight days to three hours, and cut the time needed to respond to and resolve problems by 25%.

evidence_quotes: With integration as a priority, Mastek selected ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM).
Processes as diverse as visitor management, cybersecurity, and application maintenance were consolidated on ServiceNow ITSM as the single system of action.
Today, more than a third of service requests are automated through ServiceNow ITSM.

Software updates, a process that used to take eight days as human intervention was needed to validate the application and approve the software deployment, now takes just three hours, a 98% reduction in time.
Mastek has integrated ServiceNow with Microsoft Azure Data Lake and Microsoft Power BI to provide service support related dashboards on to the single dashboard.
